note: Most runosong lives in archives rather than on named releases; this is one 1939 field recording plus modern singers who sing the old poems, so the albums are the best way in.

size.basis: Archive side: SKVR holds over 89,000 Kalevala-metre texts but these are texts, not recordings; SKS sound archives (wax cylinders from 1905, tapes) hold more field recordings, few issued commercially (Ondine's Kalevala Heritage spans 1905-1967). Revival side: a handful of specialist singers (Korhonen, Hoffrén, Kurki-Suonio, Turkka, Langeland, Käppi) each with a few runo-based albums. Estimate of issued, listenable tracks is a rough count, not a catalogue total.
